description: Reports the state of a phasor sample by sample: which way it is moving, whether it is moving at all, and where it resets

inputs.text: The phasor being analysed, 0-10V; voltages outside that range wrap back into it

outputs.text: 5V while the phasor is ascending, -5V while it is descending, and 0V while it is not moving
10V while the phasor is moving, 0V while it is stopped
A trigger each time the phasor's value falls by more than half in one sample, which is the ordinary end-of-cycle reset; a reset from part-way through a cycle can be missed
A trigger on any large proportional change in the phasor's value, catching resets the Reset output misses and often firing when a paused phasor starts again
The change in the phasor's slope from one sample to the next, -5V to +5V; 0V on a plain linear phasor except at its reset point

notes: on extremely slow phasors, around 1000 seconds per cycle, rounding error drives the measured slope to zero and the Direction and Active outputs burst with noise
a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
